title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit into a world governed by dream logic, wordplay, and wonderfully unreasonable creatures.

title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A London lawyer investigates the disturbing connection between the respectable Dr Jekyll and the violent Mr Hyde.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
description: Dorothy crosses the strange and colourful land of Oz with three companions searching for what they believe they lack.

title: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
description: Victor Frankenstein creates life and abandons it, beginning a tragedy of isolation, responsibility, and revenge.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
description: Private lives become entangled with revolution in London and Paris during the most violent years of the French Revolution.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A boy, a map, and a crew of dangerous sailors set out in search of Captain Flint's buried treasure.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man remains outwardly unchanged while a hidden portrait records the cost of his choices.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Letters, diaries, and reports document Count Dracula's journey to England and the group determined to stop him.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: The fierce bond between Catherine Earnshaw and Heathcliff shapes two generations on the Yorkshire moors.

title: Jane Eyre: An Autobiography
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess insists on dignity and independence while confronting love, secrecy, and social constraint.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Fitzwilliam Darcy repeatedly misjudge one another amid family pressure, class, and courtship.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
description: An unexpected fortune changes Pip's ambitions and exposes the illusions behind gentility and success.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Twelve cases display Sherlock Holmes's powers of observation through the admiring account of Dr Watson.

title: Moby-Dick; or, The Whale
author: Herman Melville
description: Ishmael joins the Pequod and its captain's obsessive pursuit of the white whale Moby Dick.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Holmes and Watson investigate an inherited curse and a terrifying hound on the fog-bound Devon moor.
